description: OCR: read the text in a photo, scan or scanned PDF, in English and Indian languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, Marathi).

file.description: The file, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works). Up to 5 MB.

lang.description: Languages the text uses, joined by +: eng, hin, tam, tel, kan, mal, ben, guj, pan, ori, mar. Up to three. Default eng.

name: read_text_in_image
title: Read text in image
